rootCause: The operator service on Linux was started without CREWROOM_RUNTIME_CONFIG (health executionAvailable=false). The workflow, and with it the model catalog, exists only with runner configuration, so the workspace omitted modelDiscovery and Models & budget plus the role override rendered free-text fields.

Independently, discovery accepted only the exact MH4 versions (codex-cli 0.162.0, 2.1.296 (Claude Code), omp/18.4.12). The installed codex-cli 0.163.0, 2.1.302 (Claude Code) and omp/18.11.3 would each have failed discovery with a generic version message even with a runner configured.
